variation_slice.source: homo_sapiens/116_GRCh38/21/all_vars.gz of the Ensembl VEP release-116 indexed cache
variation_slice.window: records whose start lies within one base of an input record's span
variation_slice.slice_check: Ensembl VEP 116.3 run on this slice and on the full cache wrote identical default-format output for every record under --check_frequency --freq_pop AF --freq_freq 0.01 --freq_gt_lt gt --freq_filter exclude, under --check_existing and under --check_existing --filter_common

filter_common_check.statement: Ensembl VEP 116.3 on variants.vcf against the full release-116 GRCh38 cache writes the same records with the same values under --check_existing --filter_common as under --check_existing: its 1KG_ALL population reads minor_allele, 1KG_ALL and ALL, which a release-116 cache lacks (BaseCacheVariation.pm:214-244), so --filter_common filters nothing and FREQS stays empty; vep-rs reads the AF column for 1KG_ALL (docs/intended-divergences.md)

summary_log.annotation_rows: equal to the expected outputs' rows; the two runs differ only in the header lines that name a time, the cache path or the command line
